title: A Polyhedral Formula for $n\times2\times2$ Kronecker Coefficients via Cluster Algebras
summary: Let \[ \Bbbk[\Bbbk^3\otimes\Bbbk^2\otimes\Bbbk^2]^{U_3\times U_2\times U_2}. \] We construct an ordinary cluster family with Markov principal part. At $ζ=-1$, the intersection of its initial Laurent ring with the three adjacent Laurent rings equals $\mathscr U$, and \[ \mathscr U=\mathcal M_u[u_Δ], \] where $\mathcal M_u$ is the middle algebra. Its theta functions are indexed by a cone with a sixteen-element Hilbert basis.
